items.title: Charlie Love Interview, 1958-06-19, 20
items.q: Howard Walker come down there with his big old bus. He was getting the band to go to Minnesota.

ctx.x: Did you play the regular Mexican music? Oh yeah.

They're good musicians and they got the music ranged up. Were you ready? Towards last, yeah. Towards last they had got a good job before they blew up that track there. We were going to Mexico City. I had done practiced up with the band. They had a good job there. Twenty dollars a night, all expense paid. Just stay right in the hotel. And tips. Oh, I'd have had some do when I come back there. So the fella had done, made the contract some kind of way. And shortly after that, that's why they blew up the track at…
Who was in the band then?
